sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Supply Plans is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, young man. Truly glad to see you. I have a very important assignment, not for everybody to take on. Will you take it? Then listen. Do you know the sawmill in the Woods? So, during the Contract Wars period, it was used as one of the makeshift backup supply bases for TerraGroup. And I am very interested in TerraGroup supply plans in this region. I think they should be somewhere on the territory as well. Try to search for the temporary quarters for workers - there should be a secure case for documents with a special symbol."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain Secure Folder 0052 in the sawmill cabin on Woods
- Survive and extract from the location
- Hand over the folder

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- Therapist Rep +0.1
- 80,000 Roubles
  - 84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Can’t stop wondering at the reliability of your services. Here is your cut."

sections.heading: Failure Dialogue
sections.text: "Honestly, I did not expect that from you! With these plans, we could've found and sold—... Khm, sent food to civilians, but now all this wealth goes to Skier who'll just vend it all for ten times the price! How could you team up with this scoundrel?"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Secure Folder 0052 | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
The documents are located at the lumber camp on Woods, under a bed in the wooden cabin #3.
